commit_message_template: v46.1: Day 98 — IRGC escalates to direct strikes on allied infrastructure; F2 resolves NO; F1 moves to 50%
direction_of_travel: The IRGC's June 2-3 escalation into direct strikes on allied infrastructure, combined with the simultaneous failure of the F2 diplomatic deadline, has shifted the short-term probability distribution toward protracted military impasse: F1 moves to 50% while F5 falls to 18%, reflecting a widening gap between closure risk and recovery capacity.
